title: Updating protocolFeeTo
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  SofamonWearable has the following functions to update the fee receiver.  ```solidity     function updateRoyaltyFeeTo() public {         royaltyFeeTo = ISofamonWearableFactory(machine).protocolFeeTo();          emit NewRoyaltyFeeTo(royaltyFeeTo);     } ```  So, `royaltyFeeTo` should always be updated manually.  Some bad scenarios are possible:  1. By default it is set to `address(0)` if the function was never called => royalties sent to zero address 2. `machine` can be updated => royalties sent to the deprecated address 3. `pro
